content.title: Eagle Point Credit (ECC) Earnings Transcript
content.summary: The CLO equity investments that we made during the quarter had a weighted average effective yield of 16.9%.  Additionally, during the quarter, we proactively completed 16 refinancings and 11 resets which strengthened our CLO equity portfolio's earning power and helped partially offset the loan repricings that we faced throughout the year.  During the quarter, the company generated net investment income less realized losses from investments of $0.16 per share, consisting of 24¢ of net investment income and offset by 8¢ of realized losses from sales on certain investments.
